cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Test the Impossible Claim
cards.instruction: Get someone else to take the first practical step that could prove the bizarre claim true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. There's an invisible bridge across this ditch. Tap for it with your umbrella before I cross.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Yours extends. You can test it without leaving the bank.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll probe. But a surface isn't proof it'll hold you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Slide your picnic basket onto it first. Leave my lunch inside; I want a convincing weight.

mechanism: A corrects tool choice and test loading while getting B to take the first step toward proving an invisible bridge exists.
confusable: D149 delegates impossible execution; the probe and basket are ordinary actions intended to test the impossible premise.
comparison: A physical crossing test differs from requesting a visibly recognizable object from a kitchen tap.
seedUse: Keep reach and load concerns; use B's caution to improve a supervised test, not simply demand a leap.
